title: Slopes.
officialText:
Piping for other than dry gas conditions shall be sloped not less than 1/4 inch in 15 feet (6.3 mm in 4572 mm) to prevent
traps. The local gas supplier/utility company should be consulted to determine the type of fuel gas available for the intended service.
